name: Craftsman's Writ: Orange Martial Shirt
summary: A customer's writ requests an Orange Martial Shirt and gives delivery and payment details. The writ can pass from hand to hand.

sections.title: The Delivery
sections.body: The note gives the delivery place and payment terms. You need the writ with you to complete the exchange, and the requested shirt is an Orange Martial Shirt.

faq.answer: The customer requests one Orange Martial Shirt.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the shirt?
faq.answer: The delivery location is marked on your map.

faq.q: What do I need for the transaction?
faq.answer: You need the requested shirt and the writ in your possession.

faq.q: Does the writ say how payment works?
faq.answer: The note includes information about payment.
Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.
